note: Since tick 2 each citizen is its own independent bot with its own memory. Citizens write only inside agents/<id>/ (actions/tick-N.md, memory.md, outbox.md, workshop/) and may file governance/proposals/. The Chief of World opens ticks, resolves shared state, and writes the chronicle; it no longer decides what citizens do.
